clinical_review: DRAFT — written by the engineering team as a starting point. Must be reviewed and approved by the Clinical Lead before use with real clients.
name: DBT (individual)
description: Inspired by the balance of acceptance and change in DBT individual work. Our own wording. This pack reflects on technique only; it never rates risk.

scale.meaning: 1 = not present in this session, 3 = partly present, 5 = strongly and skilfully present

dimensions.label: Validation
dimensions.description: Communicating that the client's responses make sense in context, at the level the moment calls for.

anchors.5: Validation at several levels, well matched to the moment.

dimensions.label: Balancing acceptance and change
dimensions.description: Moving flexibly between acceptance and change strategies.

anchors.1: Stuck in only acceptance or only change.
anchors.5: A fluid, well-timed balance of acceptance and change.

dimensions.label: Focus on specific behaviours
dimensions.description: Working with specific, concrete behaviours and their links (e.g. chain analysis) rather than generalities.

anchors.5: Specific behaviours and links are explored in useful detail.

dimensions.label: Skills coaching
dimensions.description: Helping the client use or plan to use skills (e.g. distress tolerance, emotion regulation, interpersonal effectiveness, mindfulness).

anchors.5: Skills are actively coached and linked to the client's situations.

dimensions.label: Dialectical stance
dimensions.description: Holding seemingly opposite truths together; avoiding either/or positions.

anchors.5: A consistent dialectical stance that opens up options.

dimensions.label: Commitment and collaboration
dimensions.description: Building and checking the client's commitment to agreed goals.
